coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and personal hygiene
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Dressing in work uniform, packing bag and checking phone for shift notes
Commuting to the health care facility
Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication rounds and clinical documentation
Taking a lunch break at the facility
Continuing clinical duties: patient care, handover preparation and record updates
Commuting home from the health care facility
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
Cleaning up after dinner and loading the dishwasher, running it before the electricity price rise
Laundry: washing and drying work clothes
Using the computer at the desk to review study material and check tomorrow's roster
